positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Architected a unified logistics, billing, and analytics ecosystem from design to deployment, transforming the customer experience by consolidating fragmented legacy tools into a single-platform solution that secured new enterprise accounts and drove upsell opportunities.
- Engineered a scalable design system by consolidating legacy CSS into reusable components, which standardized UI/UX patterns and accelerated feature development cycles.
- Modernized core features for 100+ daily active users across 30 businesses by incorporating feedback and aligning sprints with churn reduction goals.

Technologies: JavaScript, React, Jest, Ruby, Rails, Rspec, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Sidekiq.

positions.title: Software Engineer 3
positions.description:
- Re-engineered a high-traffic drug selection component, significantly reducing erroneous drug codes and prescription bounce-backs, which optimized on-time delivery rates and reduced on-call engineer interventions.
- Pioneered user flows for a new internal pharmacy application to track inventory from intake to fulfillment, ensuring FDA compliance and reducing shrinkage.
- Standardized front-end testing by implementing React Testing Library; established accessibility-driven testing patterns that increased code coverage and minimized regressions during refactors.

Technologies: TypeScript, React, Jest, React Testing Library, Ruby, Rails, RSpec.

positions.title: Career Break
positions.description: Pursuing medical school (volunteering, MCAT, applications, etc)

positions.title: Software Engineer 1
positions.description:
- Developed a robust, cross-browser front-end application used in merchant test pilots, ensuring compatibility across all form factors and delivering successful pilot results that lifted user retention and average order value (AOV).
- Launched a secure internal admin portal that bypassed manual merchant onboarding bottlenecks while maintaining PayPal security standards.

Tech Stack: JavaScript, React, Redux, Mocha, Express.js, GraphQL, Jenkins.

positions.title: Extraction Laboratory Technician
positions.description:
- Followed strict standard operating procedures for processing water, soil, and other media.
- Kept thorough and accurate records to provide thorough and defensible data to clients.

positions.title: Universal Agent (Intake Coordinator)
positions.description: - Processed incoming faxes and online enrollments quickly and accurately to help patients receive insurance benefits in a timely manner.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
- Led individual mini-studies investigating correlation between tomato flower strain, trichome density by type, known acyl-sugar production levels, and western flower thrips growth and survivability.
- Used microscope to dissect flowers for insect count to provide data in long-term study.
- Employed sterile technique, utilize micropipettes, and prepare samples for assays.

positions.title: Assistant Technician
positions.description:
- Learned mechanisms of a variety of medical and research devices in order to disassemble, clean, and reassemble accordingly.
- Operated machinery to create custom metal parts for customers and machinery.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
- Utilized machinery for data sampling throughout wafer process development studies within clean room environment.
- Diced silicon wafers before imaging in Scanning Electron Microscope for visualization of plasma etching results.

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Took patient vitals including blood pressure, heart rate, and respiratory rate prior to patient-doctor interaction.
- Translated between Mandarin-speaking patients and English-speaking medical professionals to facilitate communication and ensure proper medical care.
- Kept clinic running smoothly through receptionist responsibilities, pulling and organizing patient files, and following up with patients, doctors' offices, and pharmacies.

- Retrieved, filed, and organized medical records for the Medical Records department.
- Cleaned, prepared, and restocked patient rooms and checked up on patients and their families to promote patient satisfaction within the Emergency Room department.

projects.title: Bomb Tag
projects.description: Bomb Tag is based on the Bomb Tag level from the game Move or Die and is made with Javascript and utilizes HTML5/Canvas for game rendering.

projects.title: Clocked-In
projects.description: Clocked-In is a light-weight chrome extension that keeps track of how much time you've spent on various sites.
